Fix private commits missing from home commit graph (#25)

The graph fetched contributions via the GraphQL contributionsCollection
API, which omits private-repo commits unless GitHub's "include private
contributions on my profile" toggle is on and a chain of other visibility
rules line up. Even with the toggle on, org private repos (exa-labs) can
be dropped from the per-repo breakdown.

Switch to the search/commits REST API, which returns every commit the
token can see regardless of the profile toggle. Private and exa-labs
commits now surface as long as the token has access to the repo, keeping
the existing exa/private display labels and 30-day window.

Extract ProjectRow to a client component to fix Featured rendering

ProjectRow was defined inline in page.tsx (a Server Component). The
<button> JSX it passed to ProjectDrawer was serialized as a React lazy
reference crossing the server→client boundary. vaul's Drawer.Trigger
asChild can't Slot-clone a lazy ref, so it suppressed the children —
the Featured rows came out as empty <div>s in dev and never rendered
post-hydration.

Move ProjectRow + its inner content into src/components/home/ProjectRow.tsx
with 'use client'. The button is now a regular React element when handed
to ProjectDrawer, and Drawer.Trigger asChild slots it normally.

Pre-bake OG image cache for /stack

active category, leaving the grid stuck on spinners until external
sites responded. The new build-og-cache.mjs script resolves all 141
non-YouTube stack URLs once and writes og-cache.json (121 hits, 20
nulls). The hook now seeds from this on mount, so first paint of /stack
is instant.

Run pnpm build-og-cache after adding new stack items.

Cap FadeIn stagger on /stack and /skills

making first paint feel slow even when data was already in memory. Cap
the stagger at 12 items so anything past the 12th lands at the same
delay as the 12th — keeps the stagger feel without the drag.
